comment: Maps source files to the PHPUnit test files that cover them, for running only the tests of a change. 'map' holds hand-made entries (a path or an fnmatch pattern, where * also matches /), 'generated' the source paths that test files name literally (regenerated), 'ignore' the files no PHPUnit test covers on purpose. See doc/eng-us/features/6.0/quality-checks.md.
